question: Vegapunk's cousin Vegapants is apparently on Pants Hazard, but what kind of island is that and what's he like?
answer: Oh. I know that very well. Vegapants is the son of Vegapunk's father's younger brother, and he lives on Pants Hazard, an island south of Baldimore with a culture where all the residents wear women's underwear on their heads. He has an earnest and cheerful personality, but the island as a whole is set apart from the rest of the world. How nostalgic...
name: Uraneko
